description: NaLaO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four LaO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven LaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.98 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four LaO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven LaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.98 Å. There are two inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-13°. There are two shorter (2.43 Å) and four longer (2.46 Å) La-O bond lengths. In the second La site, La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-14°. There are two shorter (2.44 Å) and four longer (2.47 Å) La-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and three La atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃La₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-13°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and three La atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃La₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-13°.
